address: Strada Alessandria in San Germano 85, Casale Monferrato, 15033, Italy
bio: In what was once a typical sports bar, the friendly owner-chef serves home-style cuisine featuring traditional dishes from Monferrato and further afield. Don’t miss his plin pasta served with a roast meat sauce and a delicate cream of leeks, cotechino sausage and raw Mazara prawns. The atmosphere here is pleasantly informal and relaxed....
